TSA officers have not received paychecks since the partial shutdown of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security began on Feb. 14. The funding lapse stems from Democrats blocking a DHS spending bill while demanding changes to federal immigration enforcement following the fatal shootings of Alex Pretti and Renee Good in Minneapolis.

While most DHS functions are affected, Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) operations continue largely uninterrupted—and agents are still being paid. ICE personnel are even being deployed to major airports nationwide to assist TSA officers.

So why the discrepancy?
